description: Get ad groups. Common FieldNames: Id, Name, CampaignId, Status, Type, RegionIds, NegativeKeywords, TrackingParams, ServingStatuses, Subtype. Use when the user wants to list ad groups and their regions or statuses. Do not use it to change an ad group; call update_adgroups. Do not use it for the ads inside a group; call get_ads.
